[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Joker's role as the antagonist significantly affects Batman's relationships, forcing him to make difficult choices and sacrifices.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Batman takes the blame for Dent's death to maintain the late district attorney's reputation.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, the Joker's role creates chaos and tension that tests Batman's morals and values as Gotham's protector.
